g1.necessity: Concurrent R9 gate runs race shared probe workspaces and commit locks; without a shared phase the parallelized validation stage this delivery introduces could corrupt a concurrent gate's probe cache or produce a false CI verdict. Coordination is what makes the gate result trustworthy under concurrency.

g2.authority_owner: Host-owned R9 gate infrastructure (scripts/ci_gate.sh), executed only inside the managed R9 commit flow gated by Host-signed review admission and the staged allowlist.
g2.non_duplication: Reuses the existing worktree lock directory and fcntl locking pattern (r9-worktree.lock, r9-commit.lock); no new lock authority, daemon or scheduler is introduced and no existing gate rule is duplicated.

g3.recovery_or_reason: The shared-phase wait is bounded; on timeout or lock failure the gate fails closed with the wait log retained in r9_gate_last.log instead of emitting a pass.
